scope: Read-only CUDA replay of the existing validation field-error metric for the same frozen 54 operators. This is a numerical reproduction check, not model selection, training, or a new endpoint.
freeze_timing: This config is committed before the CUDA replay; exact commit and start/end UTC are recorded in X3_GATE_GPU_REPRODUCTION.json.
gate_source: the selected-checkpoint validation_field_nrmse recorded at the already selected update in the primary/E3 selection CSV or E5 checkpoint summary history
inputs: same frozen validation teacher-query snapshots, all 10 stored candidate actions, same 128-point model grid, same normalizer buffers and selected checkpoint weights
metric: per-batch FP32 accumulation of sum((operator_prediction - future_field)^2) divided by sum(future_field^2), square root after the 64-query validation set; batch size 32, matching confirmatory._evaluate_operator
acceptance: compare CUDA replay to the unchanged saved gate at four decimal places; retain full-precision CUDA value, CPU X3 value, saved gate, and absolute differences for every operator
execution: single GPU, sequential operator order, inference only; no checkpoint writes, no updates, no solver rollout
interpretation: A failure remains an acceptance failure; no gate values or tolerance may be changed.
